little things I love about you

❀
a small bouquet of memories
no. 01

The way you hum while you cook — the whole house feels safer with that sound.

no. 02

Your laugh that arrives before the punchline. It's my favorite sound in the world.

no. 03

How you always know when something's wrong, even from across a phone line.

no. 04

The grace you carry, even on the hardest days. You taught me what strength looks like.

no. 05

The way your hugs still feel like coming home, no matter how old I get.

no. 06

Every sacrifice you made quietly, hoping I'd never have to notice.

a little letter

Mom, if I could pour all the love I have for you into the sky, it would still feel small next to what you've given me. Every kindness in me started with you. Every time I'm brave, it's because you taught me how. Every time I'm soft, it's because you showed me that softness is a kind of strength too.

I hope today, and every day after, you feel as cherished as you've made me feel my whole life.

— forever yours ♥
